newsitem.title: GERMANY: Sixt says to acquire majority of MOHAG.
newsitem.headline: Sixt says to acquire majority of MOHAG.

text.p: German car rental firm Sixt AG said on Thursday that it planned, along with a Nuernberg-based insurance group, to acquire a majority stake in the Ford dealer MOHAG.
In a statement, Sixt said MOHAG is Germany's second largest deaker in Ford cars and had a sales 280 million marks in 1996.
The full name of the insurance partner in the deal is Nuernberger Versicherungsgruppe.

"Sixt is concentrating on the expansion of its core business and, with the acquisition of this majority stake, is continuing its strategy of offering a complete automobile service," the firm said in a statement.
It said it expected to see substantial synergy effects in the areas of car leasing and rental from the acquisition.
No financial details of the deal were given.
Ford Werke AG, the German arm of the Ford car company, had already given its consent to the deal, Sixt said.
